title: A Fun Luxury
text: The snacks are mostly small samples of mostly expensive but high-quality snacks.  I've priced some of the ones I like so I know.  I have done this subscription for 3 boxes so far, and have noticed some repeats of brands or actual snacks already.  Not cool.  Hard to keep up the variety perhaps, but not my problem.  If it happens too often, I'll just cancel I guess.
label: neutral
